title: Drinking-water and multi-utility companies across Italy (national coverage)
category: Single national market — HULO.ai ICP, no region restriction

input.solutionDescription: AI leak-detection and water-network monitoring software
input.businessObjective: Identify Italian water organisations actively working on NRW (non-revenue water) or leak reduction and network modernization, to shortlist for outbound marketing and eventually contact
constraints: Italy only, no region restriction — cover any Italian region, not just Lombardia and Lazio
prioritise organisations with an active, named NRW or leak-reduction initiative over generic efficiency mentions

marketSignals: Should surface NRW / leak reduction as a real, named problem area — not just generic 'efficiency'
Should look for Italian national or EU regulation, funding programmes, and tenders tied to network modernization
Signals must each carry a source and a date where a date is expected
Should include organisation-scale signals (population served, network length) for named organisations
candidates: Real, identifiable Italian water utilities and multi-utility companies (regional or municipal), not limited to Lombardia/Lazio
organisationType should be from the allowed enum, including multi-utility-company where applicable
Each candidate must carry relevance evidence, not just a name
organisationType must fit targetCustomerType — no regulators or competitors unless the run itself asks for that landscape
mustAvoid: Inventing utilities that cannot be sourced
Confusing bottled-water brands with network/utility operators
Any outreach or contact instruction in recommendations
expectedCharacteristics.sourceExpectations: Prefer Tier A/B (Italian regulators, ARERA, official utility sites, trade press) over promotional vendor pages

notes: Follows 06-water-utilities-italy after Stage 05's contact-finding was proven live; drops the Lombardia/Lazio-only constraint to test national coverage against the same ICP criteria.
